Barista
Bluebird Coffee Co.

Join Bluebird Coffee and help us brew the best cup in Salt Lake City.

What you'll do:
- Greet guests with a smile and make espresso drinks to our standards.
- Handle cash and the point of sale system accurately.
- Keep the cafe clean and follow food safety rules.
- Work as a team during the morning rush.

What we're looking for:
- Friendly, dependable people who love customer service.
- Availability for early morning and weekend shifts.
- No experience needed; we'll train you.

Bluebird Coffee Co. is an equal opportunity employer.
